adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `selectedCalendar` is now derived via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId;`. If `destinationCalendar` is non-empty but none of its entries matches the passed `credentialId`, `selectedCalendar` becomes `undefined` and the insert call uses `calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"`, which will create the event in the user's primary calendar instead of the intended destination calendar. This is a behavioral regression vs. the new intent (select by credentialId) and can cause events to be created in the wrong calendar without any error.
